name: custom-controls
description: abap2UI5 custom controls shipped outside the framework

scripts.build:local: npm run vendor:local && npm run app2bsp
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:abap2ui5 && npm run test
scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_downport: (abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc || true) && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws && abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
scripts.deps:post: npm run vendor && npm run app2bsp

skip.marked: from 18.0.14 on it has a line tools/wrap-lines.mjs cannot break under 255 characters, which the local build needs
